introduction: Olivia, Marta, and Carlota are three friends leading normal lives, until a moment of panic changes everything: an unexpected confrontation with Olivia's ex-boyfriend, Jaime, ends tragically when he accidentally dies. Consumed by the fear of losing their freedom during the best years of their lives, the three make a radical decision: to hide the body and conceal what happened that night. What begins as an act of desperation quickly devolves into an uncontrollable spiral of lies, improvised crimes, and growing paranoia. Between loose ends, unexpected mistakes, and the constant threat of discovery, they plunge into a series of crimes that become increasingly difficult to justify.
